expected_value_creation: A reviewer can reproduce why quality knowledge is transferable, conditionally transferable, or non-transferable between two domains without relying on pooled performance.
beneficiary: QIF users, affected stakeholders, reviewers, and governance owners
supporting_evidence: NIST measurement science identifies unjustified generalization beyond test settings as an open validity problem.
NIST post-deployment monitoring guidance identifies dynamic context, baseline, drift, and real-world evidence gaps.
success_criteria: Every transfer claim names source and target domains and compares construct, population, context, outcome, evidence, threshold, and confidence meaning.
Domain-local results remain separate and unsupported transfer routes governance.
